snippet.title: Delivered by Friday trailer
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4141430/Delivered_by_Friday/
Itch.io: https://emanation.itch.io/delivered-by-friday

Friday Kwon is a young witch who makes potions for her family shop. But when her mother breaks her arms in an accident, Friday returns to her post as a delivery girl for the first time since her own accident left her paralyzed from the waist down.

The Rainforest Witch Company doesn't take kindly to this and they'll do everything in their power to make sure that Friday doesn't deliver any potions. Take control of Friday and navigate the unfriendly skies as she tries to get potions to her customers and keep the family business afloat. 

Prefer a more chill game? Take your time on the levels and don't sweat the small mistakes like a lost or late package. But if you like more of a challenge try your hand at being the best delivery girl whose only flaw is being a perfectionist. Or maybe you prefer something in between? The choice is yours.

    Gameplay and story by Emerson Arriety

    Background and story art by SleepySoren

    Sprite art by Vioclipse

    User interface art by Frances Genevieve Philip

    Music by Apocalyptic Universe
